answer: Escrowed reputation dividend. Each identity must escrow a fixed deposit and earn payouts only from a shared dividend pool split by verified contribution, not headcount. A cedar benchmark logs each actor's output. Cloning adds no dividend share, so attackers pay full escrow per clone while honest actors near a mesa of steady yield. Withdrawal requires a yarrow audit trail. Per-identity cost: one escrow deposit plus audit overhead, unrecovered when clones fail benchmarks.
